sentence_stem: The manager denied the mistake, although
correct_completion: the report clearly showed it was his error.
full_sentence: The manager denied the mistake, although the report clearly showed it was his error.

options.text: he apologised to the whole team.
options.why_wrong: An apology does not provide the contrasting evidence that 'although' requires after the denial.

options.text: the report clearly showed it was his error.
so the team had to work late.
options.why_wrong: 'So' expresses result, not contrast. 'Although' needs a clause that opposes the denial.

options.text: he had been on holiday that week.
options.why_wrong: This gives a reason for the mistake, not a contrast to the denial, so it does not fit the meaning of 'although'.

explanation: After 'although', the clause must contrast with the main clause. Here the denial is contrasted with evidence that shows the manager was wrong. Portuguese speakers may be tempted to choose a result clause, but 'although' signals opposition.
translation: O gerente negou o erro, embora o relatório tenha mostrado claramente que o erro era dele.
